voiceoverScript: A lug nut can thread on and still be wrong. Thread size is only one part of fit. The seating surface must also match the wheel. A mismatch can clamp the wheel incorrectly. Verify the complete hardware application before installation.
selectedCaption: Wheel-fastener compatibility depends on thread, seating surface, and required engagement for the wheel and vehicle application. A lug nut can thread onto the stud and still be wrong for the wheel. Nick's Tire & Auto can inspect the actual vehicle or tire before parts are replaced.
